character.label: the war of horns and cannon

programs.brief: A majestic rearing unicorn colossus sculpted from pure white quartz, gold, and polished diorite, standing on a fortified coastal promontory facing the pirate sound, horn radiating protective beacon light.
A menacing dark-oak and blackstone sea fortress built like the jutting bow of a colossal war galleon, with rows of heavy iron cannons and tattered black sails bristling toward the unicorn island.
A floating amethyst crystal core pulsing above a glowing quartz runic pedestal with defensive energy arcs.
A heavy naval broadside cannon mounted on a dark timber carriage behind a sandbag and barrel parapet facing the strait.
